name: Parallel Verification
description: Splits an oversized verification pass across several read-only verifiers so TPM buys wall-clock latency, then adjudicates the slice verdicts and the not-checked ledger back into one session verdict.

splitThreshold.label: Split Threshold
splitThreshold.description: Changed-file count at or above which TPM splits verification across several agents. Fan-out costs MORE total tokens than one verifier — it buys latency, not savings. Setting near 1 gets the cost with none of the benefit.

maxSlices.label: Max Slices
maxSlices.description: Hard ceiling on concurrent verifiers per pass (includes the whole-picture verifier; also bounded by QA/SWE concurrency caps). Raise for wide changes with spare capacity; lower to cap fan-out cost.

sliceAxis.label: Slice Axis
sliceAxis.description: How TPM partitions a pass. by-file (default, safe): each verifier gets a disjoint set of changed files, preserving the full QA checklist per file. by-check-type: each verifier covers one check class across the whole diff — only valid if the dispatched types together cover all 8 QA checklist dimensions.

sweVerifierOverflow.label: SWE Verifier Overflow
sweVerifierOverflow.description: When on, TPM may staff overflow verification slices with SWE agents in Verification Mode once QA slots are exhausted — strictly read-only, never edits. When off, a pass is capped at the QA concurrency limit.

wholePictureSlice.label: Whole Picture Slice
wholePictureSlice.description: When on, one extra verifier reads the whole diff for cross-cutting checks only (side effects, cross-file consistency, scope, duplication) — never per-file correctness. When off, coupling defects spanning two slices are more likely to escape.
